findings.current: According to what Zhuge Feng had said, the Sea Serpent Society Head and a thousand of his men had been buried beneath the waters of Red Cliffs a fortnight ago.
findings.defect: The stated interval contradicts Zhuge Feng's account that he received news of the massacre one month ago and his later statement that a full month has passed.
findings.rationale: Using one month maintains the explicit chronology established in Chapters 445 and 446.
findings.replacement: According to what Zhuge Feng had said, the Sea Serpent Society Head and a thousand of his men had been buried beneath the waters of Red Cliffs a month ago.
findings.source: Chapter 446, narration after the Quest window

findings.current: If Donghu Stronghold really was responsible for the two incidents that had occurred over the past fifteen days, just as the circumstances revealed so far suggested… then a clash of martial force might take place, in accordance with the laws of Murim.
findings.defect: The fifteen-day interval contradicts the established month-long chronology of the Sea Serpent Society massacre.
findings.rationale: The Sea Serpent Society was destroyed approximately one month earlier, while the Dongting Fisherman disappeared only three days earlier.
findings.replacement: If Donghu Stronghold really was responsible for the two incidents that had occurred over the past month, just as the circumstances revealed so far suggested… then a clash of martial force might take place, in accordance with the laws of Murim.
